title: Smarter WhatsApp assistant
how: In the team group, write: lumina summary (or: lumina summary yesterday / monday / 12 oct). Add a task to someone from Daily Standup and they get a WhatsApp automatically.
bullets: Group summary now comes split by topic with an Important section on top. Days run 3 AM to 3 AM; ask for yesterday, a weekday or a date like 12 oct.
When someone hands you a task from the Daily Standup, you now get a WhatsApp message straight away.
Reminders list your open tasks one per line, so they are easier to read.
The Calendar counts 9 hours or more as a full day.
